svg.title: Observed Windows scratch directory access comparison
svg.desc: In the restricted Windows source checkout, mkdir mode 0700 caused PermissionError. Creating a scratch directory with inherited ACLs allowed create, read and delete. This is a rendered observation chart, not a screenshot or a blanket permission guarantee.
